items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Henry Koger (PHONETIC), and oh gee, I can't name them.

ctx.x: You see that's the thing -- I can't remember names. I wish I could. In the band with Basie we had a good trombone player, Stan Minor. He's not heard of much. No one ever heard of him but he was with Basie when I was, and Dickie Wells (PHONETIC). And Dickie Wells (PHONETIC) played a lot of lead too and that was beautiful too. He was beautiful lead trombone.

Henry Koger (PHONETIC), and oh gee, I can't name them. You know. And as far as records is concerned, then you have to go to another bag because I don't remember who all I played with in records. And there was so many great trombone -- straight lead men, you know.
It used to be -- I guess when you started playing in bands they only had one trombone very often and --
